description: Na₃La(VO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2₁ space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.95 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.97 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three VO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 83°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.60 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.59 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.62 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.67 Å. There are two inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.64 Å. In the second La site, La is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.67 Å. There are four inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-42°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.75 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-41°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.75 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-68°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.77 Å. In the fourth V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-66°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.77 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one La, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one La, and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one La, and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one La, and one V atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃V tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃LaV square pyramid, corners with five ONa₂LaV tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃LaV square pyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one La, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₂LaV tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃LaV square pyramid and corners with three ONa₃V tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one La, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₂LaV tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃LaV square pyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃LaV square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂LaV tetrahedra. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one La, and one V atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one La, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₂LaV tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃LaV square pyramids, corners with three ONa₃V tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂LaV tetrahedra. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one V atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one V atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one La, and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃LaV square pyramids. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃V tetrahedra.
